prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
The evidence is still thin to establish rules, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -3.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sign-In Reorder: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their companion before registering. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% while sign-in causes high mean delay (567s); placing sign-in post-adoption leverages user investment.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quickstart Screen: Add an interactive quickstart screen right before finishing onboarding that demonstrates pet controls and shortcuts. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once setup finishes.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Grid Redesign: Redesign the companion selection step into a modern visual grid layout with interactive choice cards. (why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s).)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Generation Photo Preview Sub-Flow: Insert a dedicated photo render preview screen after photo upload to verify custom pet generation. (why: Support logs indicate 3 separate complaints about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress and Tip Carousel: Display a explicit progress indicator, estimated time, and tip carousel while assets load. (why: The home waiting screen has a high median wait time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs before completion.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Visibility Tray Shortcut Hint: Add clear helper hints and shortcut badges on the final welcome screen explaining desktop visibility toggles. (why: Three support tickets reported pets missing from the desktop or app failing to open properly post-setup.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Express Badge Incentive: Add interactive speed choice badges highlighting fast pre-made companion selection versus custom photo uploads. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite 8s median, showing some users stall making a choice.)
7: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Alert Notification: Offer a desktop notification opt-in during long render waiting screens so users can safely switch tasks. (why: Median waiting step takes 201s (mean over 38 minutes), causing drop-off while users wait in front of the screen.)
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Clarification Copy: Update sign-in headline and hints to reassure users that signing in preserves pet customization across sessions. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest support issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
9: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout Adoption Certificate: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a stage presentation with an animated seal stamp element. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and finalizing pet details needs a more rewarding, interactive presentation.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in post-adoption targets a major bottleneck by leveraging user investment.
Previous test of adding new screen at finish step showed a negative lift (-3.6%).
Adoption step drops 39.1% of users; grid redesign streamlines selection.
Addresses 3 support complaints and adoption drop, but requires a new sub-flow screen.
High wait time at home step causes drop-off; progress/tips reduce perceived wait.
Directly supported by 3 support tickets and low cost to add shortcut hints.
Addresses long mean time on path selection with quick config-based UI badges.
Mitigates extreme wait times (201s median) by allowing users to switch tasks safely.
Fixes largest support issue (8 emails) with quick copy update at sign-in step.
Improves reward feeling at adoption step, though lacks explicit support email evidence.
